LESSON: FAITH AND GOD’S PROMISES

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: THE BIBLE
Topic 2.1: Faith and God’s Promises

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Faith and God’s Promises. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How do you apply God’s promises in your daily life?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. describe the background to the call of Abraham
2. apply faith in different situations as exemplified by Abraham

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. describe the background to the call of Abraham
   In simple words: practise until you can describe the background to the call of Abraham. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. apply faith in different situations as exemplified by Abraham
   In simple words: practise until you can apply faith in different situations as exemplified by Abraham. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Faith and God’s Promises using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Faith and God’s Promises in the examples.
2. Explain Faith and God’s Promises to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Faith and God’s Promises.
4. Show that you can: describe the background to the call of Abraham

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Faith and God’s Promises using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Faith and God’s Promises important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Read Genesis 11:24-32 and Genesis 12:1 and summarise key points,
2. Read Hebrews 11:1-6 and write lessons learnt in their exercise books,
3. In turns, read and discuss Genesis 12:1-3, 15:1-6; 17:23-26, 21:1-7 and 22:1-14,
4. Team-up to role-play how God tested Abraham’s faith in Genesis 22 1-19,
5. Read Genesis 12: 2-3, 15:1- 6, 17:1- How do you apply God’s promises in your daily life? 7 8, 17:15-18 and outline the promises made by God to Abraham for presentation in class,

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. describe the background to the call of Abraham
2. apply faith in different situations as exemplified by Abraham

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
